brief.kpi: 200.000 thuê bao gia hạn gói data, giảm churn 15%
brief.notes: Chương trình tri ân thuê bao lâu năm: gia hạn gói data 4G/5G nhận thêm 50% dung lượng. Nhắm thuê bao hiện hữu dùng smartphone, hoạt động online nhiều.

labels.labeler_note: Downgraded 'Digital Activities' out of must_include — at ~50-60M reach it's too broad to justify grade-2 ('removing it would clearly hurt the campaign'); moved to acceptable. Promoted 'Social media' into must_include instead, since heavy social use is a more specific proxy for '4G/5G data renewal, hoạt động online nhiều' than the generic behavior segment. must_exclude=New Active Business kept: brand-new business owners have distinct billing/usage patterns from the long-tenure personal subscribers this loyalty renewal targets — weak but brief-specific, not copy-pasted filler.
